meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文字、数据或品牌标志变成几秒钟的动效短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用几秒钟的动效视频讲清一个点,又不想动专业剪辑软件。
copy.tagline_en: Turn text, stats, or a brand mark into a few-second animated clip
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a few-second animated video that makes one point, without pro editing tools.

howto.what: Claude 会为你做一段 10 秒内、无旁白无真人的设计感动效短片(动态文字、数字跳数、图表、logo 揭示等),产出 MP4 或透明叠加层文件。流程自动跑完,渲染前会先问你要预览还是直接渲染。
howto.when: 当你要做 10 秒内、无旁白的设计驱动动效短片时接管;更长、带旁白或多场景的会转给 /general-video,方向不明先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 做一段 5 秒动效短片:标题逐字弹出,数字从 0 滚到 1200
say.note: 走 kinetic-type 与 stat 类流程

say.text: 给我做段 logo 揭示动画,最后停在品牌锁定画面
把这条新闻标题做成动效短片,带关键事实标注
say.note: 走 news 类别,会先检索素材

howto.what_en: Claude builds a short, design-led motion graphic (kinetic type, stat count-up, charts, logo reveal, maps) — ~10s, no narration — and renders it to MP4 or a transparent overlay. Before rendering it asks: preview or render?
howto.when_en: It takes over when you want a short (~10s or less), unnarrated, design-led motion graphic. Longer, narrated or multi-scene pieces go to /general-video; if it's unclear, /hyperframes decides.
